verdict.rationale: Probe evidence implies irs.gov serves a real robots.txt: the Form 15620 probe notes "/dmaf is not disallowed by irs.gov robots.txt", and the app-host probe refers to "the irs.gov content robots.txt". However, the application host that runs the EIN online assistant (sa.www4.irs.gov) returned HTTP 503 for robots.txt. So an agent cannot learn its permissions there before fetching. Missing for 10: a direct probe or citation of the irs.gov robots.txt and its contents, a stable robots.txt on the application hosts (sa.www4.irs.gov), and evidence that the rules cover the transactional flows an agent would actually use.
